name: svsch
description: Generate interactive visual block diagrams from SystemVerilog projects.

commands.title: SVSCH: Reset Layout For Current Module

svsch.veriblePath.description: Path to the Verible verible-verilog-syntax executable.

svsch.parser.backend.description: Parser backend used to extract the design graph.

svsch.includePaths.description: Workspace-relative paths to search for include files.

svsch.defines.description: Macros to define for the preprocessor (e.g. { "DEBUG": "1" }).

scripts.compile: npm run clean && CI=true npx vite build && npx tsc -p tsconfig.extension.json && npm run compile:backend && SURELOG_AUTO_INSTALL=1 npm run install-surelog && npm run build:cli
scripts.compile:backend: mkdir -p src/parser/backend_cpp/build && cd src/parser/backend_cpp/build && cmake .. -G Ninja && ninja svsch_backend && mkdir -p ../../../../dist/ && cp svsch_backend ../../../../dist/
scripts.package: SURELOG_AUTO_INSTALL=1 npm run compile && npx vsce package
scripts.lint: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.extension.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.webview.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.cli.json
scripts.test:backend: export PATH=$PATH:$(pwd)/dist/surelog/bin && mkdir -p src/parser/backend_cpp/build && cd src/parser/backend_cpp/build && cmake .. -G Ninja && cmake --build . --target svsch_test && ./svsch_test
scripts.test:bdd: npm run build:webview && npm run build:extension && npm run build:cli && npx bddgen --config test/bdd/playwright.config.ts && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE xvfb-run --auto-servernum playwright test --config test/bdd/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:bdd:update: npm run build:webview && npm run build:extension && npm run build:cli && npx bddgen --config test/bdd/playwright.config.ts && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE xvfb-run --auto-servernum playwright test --config test/bdd/playwright.config.ts --update-snapshots
scripts.test:system:single: env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE xvfb-run --auto-servernum playwright test --config test/system/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:system:single:update: env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE xvfb-run --auto-servernum playwright test --config test/system/playwright.config.ts --update-snapshots
scripts.test:system: node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('vscode-versions.json', 'utf8')).forEach(v => { console.log('Testing VSCode ' + v); require('child_process').execSync('VSCODE_VERSION=' + v + ' npm run test:system:single', { stdio: 'inherit' }); })"
scripts.test:system:update: node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('vscode-versions.json', 'utf8')).forEach(v => { console.log('Updating VSCode ' + v); require('child_process').execSync('VSCODE_VERSION=' + v + ' npm run test:system:single:update', { stdio: 'inherit' }); })"
